Engaging with the locals is a part of the charm of Copenhagen. From buzzing cafes to cozy pubs, expect warm smiles and interesting conversations wherever you go.

While Copenhagen may be known for its relatively high cost of living, its efficient public transportation system helps keep daily expenses in check, especially when it comes to exploring the city.
